features: Server 5's episode list actually works now — its library parser never matched the real library file, so the server could never match any title; it now reads the real shape and looks titles up by AniList id when the id is already known

Episode lists no longer hide episodes a server doesn't have — when the AniList count says more episodes aired than the winning list holds, the missing numbers appear as bare rows that resolve through the next server instead
fixes: Fixed Server 5 never returning any episode list — its parser only handled a top-level array or an id-keyed object, but the live library is a {built, titles} wrapper with hosting nested under lib (folder, eps, audio, subs) and episodes as a count; the parser now reads the real shape and reports a partial library as incomplete instead of failing

Fixed episode lists silently dropping episodes — a partial server list used to win over the AniList count, so episodes the server lacked simply never appeared; missing numbers are now padded in as bare rows that download through the next working server
